Question: Ralph went to the store and bought \(12\) pairs of socks for a total of \(\$24\). Some of the socks he bought cost \(\$1\) a pair, some of the socks he bought cost \(\$3\) a pair, and some of the socks he bought cost \(\$4\) a pair. If he bought at least one pair of each type, how many pairs of \(\$1\) socks did Ralph buy?
